sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Public list of database exports
sections.what: Gives the rest of the project one set of database names, including the client, record types, and fixed option lists such as timeline event types.
sections.why: Likely reason: a single public door keeps other packages from depending on generated files.
sections.watch_out: A new enum added to the schema must also be added here, or other packages cannot import it.

summary: The public entry point of the database package. It passes along the database client and the shared type names and fixed value lists.
purpose: Lets other packages import database tools, record types, and option lists from one place.
why: Likely reason: keeps other packages from importing generated files directly.
how: First it re-exports the database client and the Prisma helper. Then it re-exports a list of record types. Last it re-exports a list of fixed value sets, such as timeline event types, health status, gender, and notification types, that apps use as options.
inputs: The generated client code produced from the Prisma schema.
outputs: Names other packages can import, including the client, record types, and enum values.
risks: If a name is removed or renamed in the schema, this file and every package that imports it will break. Every listed name must exist in the generated code.
debug: If another package cannot find a name, check that the name is listed here and that the client has been regenerated. Run the database generate step.
